summary: Maintenance verification: no repository updates; existing integration and configuration discrepancies retained for review
changes: No package, service, desktop, driver, permission or job changes. Created private audit evidence, an isolated repository query database, updated audit pointers and prepared this sanitized receipt. Existing maintenance scheduling preserved.
tests: Current repository query returned the documented no-updates status with empty output and no errors. Package database checks passed before and after. Package inventory, selected configuration hashes and jobs were unchanged. Package file checks passed for the checked kernel, graphics libraries, application and Intel/AMD Vulkan drivers; systemd reported one journal-directory group metadata discrepancy. Local ChatGPT login status was valid. Compatibility identity still matched the last checked installation and differed from the approved baseline; no worker was started.
rollback: No system changes require rollback. Previous audit pointers and contract retained privately. No downgrade, permission change, reboot or job restart performed.
problem: Compatibility acceptance remains incomplete. Observed desktop differs from the recorded KDE preference, administrative-directory mode differs from the historical setting, and one package metadata check reported a journal-directory group discrepancy. These observations do not establish an upstream distribution defect.
solution: Recorded local proposals for reconciliation in the appropriate interactive context. Preserved the failed state, compatibility baseline, desktop, permissions and existing jobs pending the necessary specific decisions.
reproduction: A fresh isolated repository query, package database and file checks, package and service inventory, and compatibility identity comparison reproduced the documented observations without executing an integration worker. No graphics, gaming, local model or performance workload was run.
